reason: Real tagops-mcp stdio server exposes 29 implemented tools backed by Google Tag Manager v2 API operations and local audit/template functionality.
exposure: 29 tools registered by default; --read-only registers 23 tools, omitting six creation/install/sync tools while retaining guarded rollback/promote and webhook sending.
limitations: Only initialize/tools/list executed offline with an isolated HOME and scrubbed subprocess environment; handlers and authenticated API behavior were reviewed statically, not invoked.
gtm_implement_pixel uses a generic Custom HTML scaffold for unmatched templates/actions: this queues local payloads and requires replacement with real vendor code.
gtm_sync_containers invokes syncContainers without silent:true; that helper writes progress via console.log, potentially contaminating the stdio MCP transport.

tools.name: gtm_list_tags
tools.description: List all GTM tags in the current workspace. Returns each tag's ID, name, type, firing trigger references, and paused status. Use this to understand the current tag landscape before making changes or running audits. Success: a complete JSON array of all tags with their key metadata.
tools.behavior: Fetches current workspace tags using the Google Tag Manager API and returns key metadata.

tools.name: gtm_get_tag
tools.description: Get the full configuration of a specific GTM tag by its numeric ID. Returns all parameters, consent settings, firing triggers, and metadata. Use this when you need the complete tag definition for debugging, auditing, or cloning. Requires the numeric tag ID from gtm_list_tags.
tools.behavior: Retrieves the full workspace tag definition by ID using the GTM API.

tools.name: gtm_list_triggers
tools.description: List all GTM triggers in the current workspace. Returns each trigger's ID, name, and type (page view, custom event, click, etc.). Use this to understand what user actions are being tracked and to find available trigger IDs for creating new tags. Success: a complete JSON array of all triggers.
tools.behavior: Fetches current workspace triggers using the GTM API and returns IDs, names and types.

tools.name: gtm_list_variables
tools.description: List all GTM variables in the current workspace. Returns each variable's ID, name, type, and the data layer key it reads (if applicable). Use this to understand what data is available for tag configuration and to verify variable naming conventions. Success: a complete JSON array of all variables.
tools.behavior: Fetches workspace variables using the GTM API and returns data layer references when present.

tools.name: gtm_create_html_tag
tools.description: Create a Custom HTML tag in GTM with specified trigger and consent settings. The HTML content is automatically sanitized against dangerous patterns (eval, document.cookie, etc.) and untrusted domains. Use this to implement vendor tracking pixels by providing the HTML snippet, a trigger ID, and the consent type. Always verify the trigger ID exists via gtm_list_triggers first.

html.description: HTML content for the tag (script or img)

profile_name.description: Optional named profile from .gtmrc.json to scope the write operation.

tools.behavior: Sanitizes HTML and checks write access before creating a GTM Custom HTML tag with firing and consent settings.
tools.exposure: Default mode only; registration omitted under --read-only.

tools.name: gtm_create_trigger
tools.description: Create a Custom Event trigger in GTM that fires when a specific dataLayer event occurs. Optionally filter by page path to restrict firing to specific pages. Use this when implementing new tracking that requires a custom trigger not already in the workspace. Returns the created trigger's metadata including its ID for use in tag creation.

event_name.description: The dataLayer event name to listen for

page_path_filter.description: Optional: filter to only fire when Page Path contains this value

profile_name.description: Optional named profile from .gtmrc.json to scope the write operation.

tools.behavior: Checks write access and creates a GTM custom event trigger with optional page path filter.
tools.exposure: Default mode only; registration omitted under --read-only.

tools.name: gtm_plan_restore
tools.description: Preview how the current GTM workspace would be restored to match a saved snapshot. This does not apply changes. Returns create/update/delete actions, counts, safety warnings, and a risk level.

snapshot_path.description: Path to the GTM snapshot JSON file to compare against the current workspace.

tools.behavior: Loads a local snapshot and compares live tags, triggers, variables and folders to produce a restore plan without applying it.

tools.name: gtm_detect_drift
tools.description: Detect semantic drift between a saved GTM snapshot and the live workspace. Reports managed drift, unmanaged additions, deleted resources, and summary counts.

snapshot_path.description: Optional path to the GTM snapshot JSON file. Defaults to gtm-snapshot.json in the current directory.

tools.behavior: Compares a local snapshot against live workspace resources and classifies semantic drift.

tools.name: gtm_policy_check
tools.description: Run TagOps governance policies against the current GTM workspace. Loads the default policy config unless a custom config path is provided and returns violations with severity counts.

config_path.description: Optional path to a policy config JSON file. Defaults to .tagops-policies.json if present.

tools.behavior: Loads local governance policies and evaluates live workspace tags, triggers and variables.

tools.name: gtm_workspace_status
tools.description: Get the current GTM draft workspace sync state. Returns whether the workspace is synced plus merge conflicts and pending workspace changes.
tools.behavior: Calls the GTM workspace getStatus API and returns sync state, conflicts and pending changes.

tools.name: gtm_workspace_create
tools.description: Create a new isolated GTM draft workspace for safe changes. Returns the created workspace metadata including the new workspace ID.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new draft workspace.

description.description: Optional description explaining the workspace purpose.

profile_name.description: Optional named profile from .gtmrc.json to scope the workspace creation.

tools.behavior: Checks write access and calls the GTM workspace create API.
tools.exposure: Default mode only; registration omitted under --read-only.

tools.name: gtm_list_versions
tools.description: List recent GTM container versions, including which version is currently live. Useful before rollback or release decisions.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent versions to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.behavior: Lists recent container versions, loads version details and marks the currently live version.

tools.name: gtm_rollback
tools.description: Roll the live GTM container back to a previous published version, or preview the rollback in dry-run mode. Returns the target version, current live version, and a change summary.

version_id.description: Container version ID to roll back to.

dry_run.description: If true, preview the rollback without publishing the target version.

profile_name.description: Optional named profile from .gtmrc.json to scope the rollback.

tools.behavior: Previews version metadata differences or publishes the selected previous container version after access checks.
tools.exposure: Registered in both modes; --read-only permits dry_run=true and rejects apply/publish.

tools.name: gtm_promote
tools.description: Promote GTM changes from a source profile into a target profile. In dry-run mode it returns the promotion plan only. In apply mode it syncs create/update changes into the target profile without deleting target-only drift.

dry_run.description: If true, return the promotion plan without applying any changes.

tools.behavior: Validates configured promotion flow and plans or applies create/update sync between profiles while retaining target-only resources; MCP does not request publishing.
tools.exposure: Registered in both modes; --read-only permits dry_run=true and rejects apply/publish.

tools.name: gtm_audit
tools.description: Perform a comprehensive workspace health check identifying missing triggers, incorrect consent settings, orphaned triggers, paused tags, duplicate names, and risky custom HTML. Use this regularly to maintain workspace hygiene and catch configuration errors before they reach production. Returns a categorized issue report with actionable findings.
tools.behavior: Inspects live tags, triggers and variables for workspace configuration, consent and HTML hygiene issues.

tools.name: gtm_consent_audit
tools.description: Analyze all tags for Google Consent Mode v2 compliance across the four required consent signals (ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization, analytics_storage). Use this to ensure GDPR/CCPA privacy regulation compliance before deployments. Returns a compliance percentage score with per-tag signal breakdown. Includes optional dry-run auto-fix mode to preview what consent corrections would be applied.

fix.description: If true, auto-fix non-compliant tags by adding required consent signals (dry run)

tools.behavior: Audits tag consent signals or previews consent fixes with fixConsentV2(true), which is always dry-run in MCP.
tools.exposure: Registered in both modes; --read-only rejects fix=true even though fixes are always preview-only.

tools.name: gtm_doctor
tools.description: Perform a system-wide health check of your TagOps installation. Validates Node.js version, .gtmrc.json configuration, authentication credentials, API connectivity, workspace resource access, and consent compliance. Use this first when troubleshooting setup issues or to verify a fresh installation is working correctly.
tools.behavior: Checks local installation/configuration/authentication and attempts GTM connectivity and resource diagnostics.

tools.name: gtm_health_score
tools.description: Generate an overall workspace quality assessment combining multiple health factors into a single 0-100 score and letter grade (A-F). Evaluates consent compliance, naming conventions, tag hygiene, custom HTML security risks, trigger coverage, duplicate detection, and container size. Use this for regular monitoring or as a CI gate to enforce minimum quality standards.
tools.behavior: Fetches workspace tags, triggers and variables and calculates a quality score and grade.

tools.name: gtm_enhanced_conversions
tools.description: Verify that Google Ads Enhanced Conversions are configured correctly per current requirements. Checks for user-provided data event tags, proper trigger alignment, consent signal configuration, and PII collection compliance. Use this when implementing or auditing conversion tracking to ensure compliance with Google's privacy requirements.
tools.behavior: Fetches workspace tags and checks Enhanced Conversions configuration and consent heuristics.

tools.name: gtm_sst_readiness
tools.description: Evaluate your workspace's readiness for server-side tagging implementation. Analyzes which tags can be migrated to server-side, reviews browser routing configuration, server clients and transformations, and tagging-server domain setup. Use this when planning SST migration to understand the effort required and identify blockers.
tools.behavior: Fetches container metadata, tags and variables plus supported clients and transformations, then assesses server-side tagging readiness.

tools.name: gtm_compare_containers
tools.description: Analyze configuration differences between two GTM environments (e.g., staging vs production) using named profiles from .gtmrc.json. Shows which tags, triggers, and variables differ, exist only in one container, or are identical. Use this before promotions to understand exactly what will change, or to diagnose environment inconsistencies.
tools.behavior: Compares tags, triggers and variables fetched under two named configuration profiles.

tools.name: gtm_sync_containers
tools.description: Copy GTM configuration elements from one environment to another while maintaining proper trigger-tag relationships through automatic ID remapping. Use this to deploy tested configurations from staging to production or sync environments after divergence. Supports dry-run preview mode to see exactly what would change before committing.
tools.behavior: Plans or applies create/update synchronization between profiles with ID and relationship remapping; forces confirmation bypass.
tools.exposure: Default mode only; registration omitted under --read-only.

tools.name: gtm_validate_capi
tools.description: Validate Meta Conversions API or TikTok Events API server-side payloads offline. Checks hashing, deduplication ids, and required formats.

payload_path.description: Path to the JSON payload file

tools.behavior: Reads a local JSON payload and validates Meta CAPI or TikTok Events API formats without contacting those APIs.

tools.name: gtm_notify
tools.description: Send a notification to a Slack or Teams webhook. Useful for alerting on audit results, drift, or deploys.

webhook_url.description: Slack or Teams incoming webhook URL

tools.behavior: Posts a supplied summary/event/optional score to a Slack, Teams or generic webhook; does not modify GTM.
tools.exposure: Registered in both modes; --read-only still permits webhook sending.

tools.name: gtm_get_architecture
tools.description: Get the GTM architecture reference: trigger IDs, variable names, and naming conventions
tools.behavior: Returns locally defined trigger and variable maps without a GTM request.

tools.name: gtm_implement_pixel
tools.description: Intelligently implement a tracking pixel from plain English requirements. Maps actions to existing triggers and creates properly configured tags.

action.description: Action type: purchase, signup, lead, content, pageview, add_to_cart, checkout, view_item

dynamic_values.description: Dynamic values to pass, e.g. {value: 'ecommerce.value', order_id: 'ecommerce.transaction_id'}

pixels.description: Array of pixel configurations to create

dry_run.description: If true, returns what would be created without making changes

profile_name.description: Optional named profile from .gtmrc.json to scope the write operation.

tools.behavior: Plans or creates template-based HTML pixel tags and triggers; unmatched vendors/actions get a local queue scaffold rather than functional vendor tracking code.
tools.exposure: Default mode only; registration omitted under --read-only.

tools.name: gtm_list_templates
tools.description: List all available pre-built integration templates (Meta, TikTok, Shopify, Impact, etc.)
tools.behavior: Returns the local template registry and required template inputs.

tools.name: gtm_preview_template
tools.description: Preview the tags and HTML that a template would create, without installing anything

pixel_id.description: Pixel/tracking ID (uses example value if not provided)

tools.behavior: Renders local template tags and HTML using a supplied or example pixel ID without installation.

tools.name: gtm_install_template
tools.description: Install an integration template into the GTM workspace. Creates all necessary tags, triggers, and variables.

dry_run.description: If true, preview what would be created without making changes

tools.behavior: Installs or previews a local integration template, creating GTM tags, triggers and variables with write access checks in apply mode.
tools.exposure: Default mode only; registration omitted under --read-only.

review.summary: Detect drift against snapshots, plan restores, check policies, and promote changes between configured container profiles.
